data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – €147.00
data.summary: The Landkreis Musterammerland Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Fenja Musterwolde for driving 18 km/h over the 30 km/h limit near a primary school on 23 September 2026. The total amount due is €147.00 (fine €115.00, fee €28.50, delivery costs €3.50), and one point is recorded in the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice for a speeding offense. You may decide whether to accept it or file an objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle — the app shows the deadline for this based on the delivery date on the envelope. If you don't object in time, the fine becomes final and the total of €147.00 must be paid within two weeks after that. Paying without objecting is treated as accepting the fine. If you think the measurement or facts are wrong, consider getting advice (e.g. from a traffic lawyer) before the deadline shown.

date.text: Die Frist von zwei Wochen beginnt mit dem Tag der Zustellung.

items.action: Decide whether to accept the fine or file a written objection (Einspruch) with the Bußgeldstelle, either in writing or in person at the record (zur Niederschrift), by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you don't object in time, the fine becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the total amount must be paid.

items.action: Pay the total amount of €147.00 to the stated account once the fine becomes final (i.e. if you do not object in time), within two weeks after that.
items.consequence: If payment is late, enforcement measures (Vollstreckung) can follow.
